selectedFix.problem: Typed port lookup uses an uncached tree traversal and then repeats the same traversal for its physical-port ambiguity check.
selectedFix.cause: Trace__findConnectedPorts resolves many cold selectors during CreateAutoplacedBreakoutPoints, before OptimizeSelectorCache warms the subcircuit port index.
selectedFix.change: Use this.selectAll(selectorRaw) in the existing typed selection branch, reusing its cached result for the ambiguity check.
selectedFix.selectionReason: The CPU profile attributes 31836 of 68846 samples to these early port lookups. Sharing the existing result removes a demonstrated redundant traversal with one replacement call, without introducing a routing strategy.
selectedFix.remainingLimitations: This is a setup performance fix. It does not resolve fanout completeness, bus lane budgets, graph search exhaustion, or detailed routing geometry/search failures.
